svg.text: Ticketing platform on AWS: 9 microservices on EKS, event-driven with Kafka
Numbers 1-5 follow one customer request from the browser to the services
Edge: TLS, DDoS and bot filtering before traffic reaches the VPC
Private subnets - Amazon EKS 1.30 (m5.large nodes, autoscale 3-20)
Private data subnets - no public route, Multi-AZ, encrypted with KMS
Each service owns exactly one datastore; no cross-service DB access.
Amazon MSK - Kafka 3.7 KRaft, 3 brokers (m5.large), CloudEvents envelopes
Kong is the only workload behind the
load balancer. JWT is verified at Kong;
Delivery, security and observability (attached to the cluster, not in the request path)
Kafka events (async, both ways = produce + consume)
Solid purple = event consumed and produced by the service; dashed purple = consume only.
